messages:
sasha: Quick question — if a client sends model: ["redwood-13b", "redwood-7b"] and routing.hints: { region: "eu", tier: "standard" }, what is the exact fallback behavior? Do we prefer the first compatible model in the list regardless of region tier, or do region/tier hints filter the candidate set first?

jared: Region/tier should filter first. We compute compatibility set by region/tier -> then pick first match in client-provided order. That lets clients express preference while still respecting locality/capacity.

sasha: Cool — so if both models are available but only the 7b is in eu-standard, we'll pick 7b even though it's second in the list?

jared: Yep. Implementation detail: routing lookup = models.filter(byRegionTier).then(pickByClientOrder). If none match, we then expand fallback rules (tier relaxation -> cross-region if allowed -> model-family fallback).

maya: Two follow-ups: 1) What's the JSON response shape when we fall back to a different model than requested? 2) Is this considered a breaking change vs current contract?

jared: For (1) we add response.metadata.selected_model and response.metadata.routing_reason (eg: "region-unavailable" or "tier-relaxed"). For (2) it's additive non-breaking — just extra metadata. We should document it in the API spec.

koen: Additive is fine, but some internal clients parse the body and assert exact token outputs. We should warn customers in release notes. Also, can we make the selected_model header machine-readable? e.g., X-Redwood-Selected-Model so proxies can quick-route?

lina: +1 on header. infra-bot can emit header on gateway level. I'll file a tiny gateway PR.

infra-bot: RFC link: https://redwood/internal/rfcs/2026/model-routing-fallback. Also created issue RW-4123 to track header + metadata changes.

maya: For backward compat tests, what should unit tests assert?
jared: Tests: 1) client-order respected after filtering 2) metadata present when selected model != first requested 3) response header present when gateway enabled 4) behavior flags for tier-relaxation toggles. Keep tests small and deterministic by mocking capacity map.

sasha: Can someone do a quick API docs snippet and a changelog blurb? I can pick up the docs if someone opens the PR.

koen: I'll open a small API contract PR with the fields and example responses. Assigning to sasha for docs and jared for tests. ETA EOD tomorrow?
sasha: Ack. Will add example JSON and one paragraph about routing precedence.
jared: I'll add unit tests and a compatibility test harness entry.

maya: One more: can we expose routing.hints precedence matrix in the console so support can debug?
jared: Good idea — console should show computed routing decision per request id. I'll add a TODO in the PR.

koen: Thanks all. If any client teams depend on strict model echoing, please @them in the PR. :eyes:

sasha: pinging @growth-team and @search to preempt regressions.

lina: gateway PR: https://git.redwood/gateway/pulls/118 — adds X-Redwood-Selected-Model header behind feature flag.

infra-bot: RW-4123 updated: gateway PR linked, API PR RW-4124 created, docs PR RW-4125 drafted.
